title: Sound Gallery - Squirrel (Natural Sounds)
author: National Park Service
changes: A red squirrel (most likely the American red squirrel, Tamiasciurus hudsonicus) giving its rattling chatter call in Yellowstone National Park. Trimmed to 0.10–2.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. US National Park Service recording (public domain).
